models.variant: effort levels low/medium/high (default)/max; adaptive thinking; context compaction beta; 1M token context beta; 128k output

models.capability_summary: Claude Opus 4.6 是 Anthropic 的旗舰模型，引入多档推理努力（low/medium/high/max）、自适应思考、上下文压缩与 1M 上下文 beta。评测覆盖代理编码/工具/搜索、法律与多语言问答：SWE-bench Verified 80.8、GPQA Diamond 91.3、ARC-AGI-2 68.8、BrowseComp 84.0。

notes: Release date 2026-02-05: article page prints no date; official newsroom index entry "Feb 5, 2026 - Introducing Claude Opus 4.6" (tier A) and platform.claude.com docs "Released February 5, 2026" agree. Note this is Feb 2026, not Dec 2025 as sometimes assumed. goal.md 12.9 cites this page as a protocol-transparency exemplar (tool use, context compaction, reasoning effort, trial count, harness, score revisions). Prose-scored rows: MRCR v2 76/18.5 and BigLaw Bench 90.2 (Harvey quote, third-party). Terminal-Bench 2.0 / HLE / GDPval-AA / BrowseComp are prose claims whose absolute values live in charts, recorded verified with not_extracted. The main benchmark table is one large image, recorded as pending rows with vision reads quarantined in notes per goal.md 12.5. Not turned into rows: NBIM 38/40 blind cybersecurity ranking (customer quote; agentic harness with up to 9 subagents and 100+ tool calls); Box 68% vs 58% internal eval lift; Rakuten 13-issues day; Claude Code agent teams; Claude in Excel/PowerPoint; US-only inference at 1.1x pricing; premium 1M-context pricing USD 10/37.50 per MTok; six new cybersecurity probes; misaligned-behavior chart (569d7486 image). 2026-09-01 audit: removed pending DeepSearchQA row — the page contains no DeepSearchQA claim or number anywhere in prose; "DeepSearchQA" appears only in the alt attribute of asset 018d6d88…-3840x2160.png, which visually renders "Agentic search / BrowseComp" (Opus 4.6 84.0 / Opus 4.5 67.8 / Sonnet 4.5 43.9 / Gemini Deep Research 59.2 / GPT-5.2 Pro 77.9, read from the live CDN image 2026-09-01). The alt text is an official-page mislabel; the BrowseComp row already records the actual chart values.
